items.title: Warren Bernhardt interviewed by Monk Rowe, Bearsville, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: And I got to play with Vincent Nguini and Bakithi Kumalo with Paul Simon, you know, the “Graceland” guys and stuff, and Tony Cedras.

ctx.x: There is something about that music, even the way, sometimes I’ve heard something — it sounds like they even tune their guitars a little bit differently.

Oh yes, it’s magical. Some great stuff. Yeah the guitar playing is something else. The best show I ever saw in my life was here at the Bearsville Theater with Youssou N’Dour. I don’t know if you know anybody that has ever heard that band. And then the second best show is Youssou N’Dour in Kingston at UPAC a couple of years ago. He had guitar players at Bearsville on each side of the stage, like in stereo, each playing something totally different and totally right. There was just nothing out of place. Great…
Let me zoom through — it’s a little hard to pick things — but when you got that Steps Ahead group going.
